versions.notes: Version-only copy of A021 for a fresh OTA attempt from A017 after OTA_HTTPMETA. Default interval 15 minutes; saved interval retained. No download-failure repair; no hardware validation. Candidate only.
Corrective candidate: immediate RS485 receive handover, Daly checksum validation, retained raw diagnostics, and start-to-start interval scheduling.
Diagnostic candidate: bounded raw Daly UART capture on failed reads plus transport breadcrumbs for investigating missed transmissions.

Bestway A526 Candidate based on A525. REET0180-only 30-minute scheduled restart; other device IDs retain two hours. Checksummed atomic NVS failure/previous-boot records preserve last failure, HTTP operation, counters, pause state and explicit restart trigger across reboot/power loss after checkpoint. Repeated identical failures checkpoint at powers of two to limit flash writes; latest RAM evidence is saved before planned restarts. BMS parser/status maps, saved reporting interval, legacy request and signed OTA remain inherited. No new watchdog or modem recovery policy. Native persistence/actual-post/actual-loop/parser tests pass; ESP32 build recorded; physical pilot pending. Owner requested automatic staging for REET0180 only.

Bestway 24/48 V Candidate based on A524 with the retained A523 parser. Owner-requested two-hour scheduled reboot. First A525 boot records the prior effective interval and resets persisted reporting to 2 minutes; later configuration changes survive reboot. Adds active/prior interval, migration, uptime, reset cause, previous portal result/failure/attempt and rb_min=120 breadcrumbs. Native parser/acquisition/migration/actual-post/actual-loop and portal fixtures pass; ESP32 build recorded. Legacy contract, BMS maps and signed OTA retained. No new modem watchdog/recovery policy; a blocked loop can delay scheduled reboot. Physical/OTA/soak validation pending. Candidate for operator staging only.

Bestway 24/48 V Candidate based on latest A523. On first A524 boot, saves the previous effective interval and resets persisted reporting to 2 minutes; later signed/local interval changes survive reboot. Adds active/previous interval, migration state, uptime, reset cause and previous portal result/failure breadcrumbs. Retains A523 BMS parser/status maps, partial handling, buzzer, legacy contract and signed OTA. Native parser/acquisition/migration/actual-post tests, proxy/ingestion fixtures and ESP32 build pass. No new modem recovery policy; field/OTA/soak validation pending. Candidate for operator staging only.

Bestway 24/48 V Candidate based on A522. Owner-specified status 0104 is idle (0 A); technician-confirmed 0009 is charging (positive raw-current magnitude). Retains per-field validity, receive diagnostics, other status handling, signed OTA and the 40% buzzer rule. Matching live ingestion resolves these codes for installed A522 reports with provenance. Synthetic parser/acquisition and ingestion tests pass; complete field frames and independent physical/soak validation pending. Candidate only.

Bestway 24/48 V partial-measurement candidate based on A521. Preserves independently valid fields from one complete known-layout frame; unknown current direction leaves current blank. Reports missing fields, no bytes, incomplete frame or no supported packet match, plus rx/pm and st/sg/ra diagnostics. Requires the matching SSPortal partial-reading proxy/ingestion/UI update before installation (currently prepared locally). Compiled and synthetic parser/acquisition/ingestion tests pass; physical BMS/OTA/soak testing pending. Candidate only; 40% buzzer threshold and fail-safe retained.

Bestway 24/48 V status-evidence candidate based on A520. Adds st/sg/ra to valid SSPortal posts and ra to failed posts. Parser/status mapping unchanged; 40% buzzer threshold retained. Compiled only; not hardware-validated or fleet-approved.
Low-SOC buzzer threshold raised from 30% to 40% (buzzer on at SOC <= 40%). Candidate for bench validation only; not field-approved.
Wired Bestway 24/48 V OTA transport repair. Candidate-only; requires the Bestway OTA runbook bench gates before any OTA proof or field use.

Bestway 80 V evidence-based current fix (A714 plus fix; capture retained). Purpose: make charge/discharge current visible on 80 V units. Maps field status words from 18 days of A711-A714 data (0x1141 charging +A; 0xC243/0xD143/0xC343 discharging -A; 0xD742/0x0642/0xC642 at full and 0xD343 idle: 0 A or -A). Validates the CRC-16/Modbus in bytes 36-37, stops comparing that CRC as a cycle count (CCC posted as 0), adds diag B7 for CRC rejects and keeps the real rejection reason. Assumptions are not yet confirmed by a labelled site capture. Candidate-only; not bench-validated.

Bestway 80 V frame-capture diagnostic candidate (A713 plus capture). Purpose: identify the real current and cycle-count words. Both A7xx units report A:0.0 on every reading and a random CCC, while SOC cycles daily. Every SSPortal post carries the raw 38-byte BMS frame (fra/frr); every fifth post adds a passive census of all 5A A5 frames on the bus (fc/fx). Frame acceptance, posted values and the legacy request are unchanged from A713. Serial admin: frames, CAPTURE:ON/OFF. Adds about 90 KB/day while capture is on. Candidate-only; not bench-validated.

Bestway 80 V parser-reliability candidate: ignores diagnostic status-sign bytes for acceptance, rejects zero voltage/SOC/temperature, requires two agreeing frames, and permits only a zero-current unknown-status fallback with remote diagnostics. Candidate-only; bench validation is required before field deployment.
Version-only Bestway 80 V OTA proof target; otherwise identical to A711. Candidate-only; the Bestway OTA runbook bench gates remain required before any OTA proof or field use.
Wired Bestway 80 V OTA transport repair. Candidate-only; requires the Bestway OTA runbook bench gates before any OTA proof or field use.
